messages:
marta: Planning to promote payments-service chart to eu-west in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Changes: toggleable rate-limiter + DB pool bump. Tagging @sanjay @emily for quick validation.
sanjay: FYI registry has v1.5.0; eu-west stable is v1.4.2. v1.5.0 includes a sidecar image bump we haven't smoke-tested.
emily: Sidecar drops FE_JWT_TTL env. App tolerates it but a scheduled batch job reads it. Need to verify cron behavior.
deploy-bot: Promotion request: payments-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (canary=10%, window=30m). Preflight: values schema OK, images pullable, CI green.
tom: Suggest pin to v1.4.2 and apply values override for rate-limiter to avoid sidecar risk during window. I'll be oncall.
emily: v1.4.2 lacks rate_limiter flag; we can enable via values override or backport later.
marta: Proposed safe path: manual 5% canary of v1.5.0 for 30m with sidecar compat_mode true and rate-limiter enabled. If stable -> ramp. If regression -> pin to v1.4.2.
sanjay: I still prefer pin-first, but agree to manual canary if oncall watches closely.
tom: I'll monitor. Rollback criteria: error-rate increase >1% or 95th latency +200ms.
emily: Canary values override: ```yaml
sidecar:
  compat_mode: true
payment:
  rate_limiter: true
  db:
    max_connections: 80
```
sre-bot: Pre-canary checklist: dashboard https://dashboard.internal/payments-eu-west, runbook https://oncall.internal/runbooks/payments. Pager: @tom.
deploy-bot: Canary started: payments-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (5%) at 3201112400. Monitoring 30m.
tom: First 10m OK. No error spikes.
emily: Cron job checked on canary pod: exit 0.
deploy-bot: Canary passed at 3201112700. Scheduling 20% increment.
sre-bot: Automated thresholds enabled: error-rate >1% or 95th +200ms triggers rollback hold.
emily: Promoted to 100% at 3201113000. Post-promote smoke checks OK.
marta: Creating release-note PR and including emergency pin sha256:beefdead. Good job.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: payments-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (100%) at 3201113200. No rollback triggered. :tada:
